app.name: Almali Library Curator for Plex
app.tagline: Shows what nobody watches in a Plex library, and removes only what you mark.
footer.disclaimer: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Plex Inc. "Plex" is a trademark of Plex, Inc.
about.intent: Almali Library Curator for Plex shows what nobody watches in a Plex library, says why in one sentence per item, and removes only what the owner marks, after a grace period and a final re-check.

removal.failed.interrupted: Removal failed: deletion was interrupted and must pass the final check again.
removal.failed.empty_scope: Removal failed: no files could be identified for this scope.
removal.failed.files_unknown: Removal failed: the state of the marked files on disk could not be verified. The media root was unreadable, a file could not be inspected before the removal, or a file of the marked scope was never seen by any attempt, which means the environment is not what the app believes (for example an offline array disk or a wrong path map). Nothing was sent. Fix the environment, then mark the item again.
removal.failed.plex_multi_version: Removal failed: the item has several versions in Plex and only one file can be verified, so nothing was sent. Decide which versions to keep and mark the item again.
removal.failed.files_present: Removal failed: files are still present on disk.
removal.failed.seasons_missing: Removal failed: the season rows of this scope are missing, so its exact scope can no longer be verified.
removal.failed.service: Removal failed: the removal service reported an error.
removal.failed.radarr_identity: Removal failed: Radarr could not be shown to own every marked file of this movie. The link is missing or stale, its identity no longer matches, its folder does not hold the files, or Radarr reports no TMDB id for it. Nothing was sent to Radarr. Check the movie, its link and its folder in Radarr, then run the final check again.
removal.failed.sonarr_identity: Removal failed: Sonarr could not be shown to own every marked file of this series. The link is missing or stale, its identity no longer matches, its folder does not hold the files, Sonarr reports no TVDB id for it, a marked season holds files outside the marked scope, Sonarr holds fewer files than the marked scope, or its payload carries no path. Nothing was sent to Sonarr. Check the series, its seasons, its link and its folder in Sonarr, then run the final check again.
removal.failed.plex_refused: Removal failed: Plex refused to delete the media. Turn on "Allow media deletion" in the Plex server settings.
removal.failed.plex_auth: Removal failed: Plex rejected the token.
removal.failed.plex_unavailable: Removal failed: Plex could not be reached.
removal.failed.shared_arr_entry: Removal refused: another library ({library}) still points at the same Radarr or Sonarr entry, so nothing was sent. Deleting it would take that library's files, unmonitor it and add an import exclusion for it. Decide which copy goes before marking this item again.
removal.failed.shared_file: Removal refused: another library ({library}) points at the same file as this removal, so nothing was sent and no file was deleted. Decide which copy goes before marking this item again.
removal.warning.arr_redownload: {service} deletions are switched off, so Plex removes this item. Plex cannot unmonitor it or add an import exclusion: {service} may download it again.
settings.arr_deletes_help: When a service is absent or switched off, Plex removes its items instead, but cannot stop that service from downloading them again.
setup.plex_required: Connect Plex to continue: it is the only required connection.

removal.cancel.not_curated: Removal cancelled: its library is no longer curated.
removal.cancel.already_gone: Removal cancelled: a complete Plex section read confirmed the scope is already gone from Plex. No file deletion was performed or verified.

error.not_found.title: Page not found
error.not_found.message: This page does not exist. Check the address, or go back to Library health.
error.method_not_allowed.title: Action not allowed here
error.method_not_allowed.message: This page does not accept that kind of request. Use the buttons on the screens instead.
error.server.title: Something went wrong
error.server.message: The app could not finish this request. Try again in a moment.
error.csrf.title: Form expired
error.csrf.message: The form was refused because its security token is missing or has expired. Nothing changed. Reload the page and try again.
error.auth_missing.title: Login is not configured
error.auth_missing.message: Set the ALC_AUTH_USER and ALC_AUTH_PASSWORD environment variables and restart the app. Until both exist, every screen stays closed.
error.auth_hash_invalid.title: Login is closed by an invalid password hash
error.auth_hash_invalid.message: The ALC_AUTH_PASSWORD_HASH environment variable is set, but its value is not a valid Werkzeug password hash, so the app stays closed even when a password is also set. Fix the hash, or remove the variable so the plain ALC_AUTH_PASSWORD or the ALC_AUTH_PASSWORD_FILE file is used, then restart the container. No password or hash value is ever shown here.
error.logout_revoke_failed.title: Sign-out could not finish
error.logout_revoke_failed.message: This browser's session was cleared, but the app could not revoke the other open sessions. Try signing out again.
login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Sign in with the user and password set at install.
login.failed: The user or the password is not correct.
login.locked: Too many failed sign-ins from this address. Try again in 15 minutes.
connections.test_explain: A test contacts every service now and saves nothing that is not saved already.
connections.plex.adds: Libraries, users and watch history. With Plex alone the app already works and can delete on its own.
